rules.agent_contact: Fred must not invent or guess agent phone numbers.

faq.question: What is Easyfind Nigeria?
faq.answer: Easyfind Nigeria is a real estate platform that helps users find properties and connect with property agents.

faq.question: What can Fred help me with?
faq.answer: Fred can help you search for properties based on location, property type, price, bedrooms, and other requirements.

faq.question: Can Fred provide an agent's phone number?
faq.answer: Yes, when a verified phone number is available in the property listing.

faq.question: Can Fred invent a property?
faq.answer: No. Fred should only provide properties retrieved from the verified property database.

faq.question: How do I post a property on EasyFind?
faq.answer: Sign in to your agent account at easyfind.com.ng/login-agent, then click 'Upload Property' on your dashboard. Fill in details, upload photos, verify location, and submit.

faq.question: How do I become an agent on EasyFind?
faq.answer: If you have a user account, go to easyfind.com.ng/upgrade-to-agent and enter your phone number to convert instantly. Or create a new agent account at easyfind.com.ng/signup-agent.

faq.question: Can Fred show me agents on EasyFind?
faq.answer: Yes! Just ask Fred to show top agents or search for an agent by name and Fred will display active EasyFind agents with their contact details.

agent_portal.description: A guide for real estate agents on accessing the Easyfind partner portal, including step-by-step instructions for publishing new rental and sales listings.
how_to_post_property: Sign in to the Easyfind agent portal at easyfind.com.ng/login-agent (or sign up at easyfind.com.ng/signup-agent if you don't have an account yet).
Once logged in, go to your dashboard at easyfind.com.ng/agent-loged.
Click 'Upload Property' or 'Add New Property' on your dashboard.
Fill in the property details: type (house, flat, land, shop etc.), location, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, and description.
Upload clear photos of the property.
Verify the location on the map.
Click 'Submit' to publish the listing. It will appear on the platform immediately.
how_to_become_agent: If you already have a regular user account on EasyFind, go to easyfind.com.ng/upgrade-to-agent.
Enter your phone number to complete the upgrade.
Your account will be converted to an agent account instantly.
You can then log in and start posting properties.
Alternatively, create a fresh agent account directly at easyfind.com.ng/signup-agent.
agent_portal.verification: Agents can get verified by paying the verification fee and completing the biometrics check. Verified agents get a badge on their profile and higher visibility on the platform.
agent_portal.boost: Agents can boost their account for higher visibility in search results. Go to easyfind.com.ng/boost-account to see available plans.

private-policy.title: Privacy Policy
private-policy.platform_summary: This privacy policy applies to Easy Find — a real estate platform for Enugu State, Nigeria. By using our platform, you agree to the practices described here.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly and information generated as you use the platform:

collected_items.details: Name, email address, phone number, and password when you register as an agent or user.
Profile photo, bio, and business details agents add to their profiles.
Photos, descriptions, prices, locations, and details of properties agents post.
NIN (National Identification Number) and biometric data (selfie) submitted during agent verification — processed by Smile ID, not stored raw on our servers.
Transaction references and payment status via Paystack. We do not store card numbers.
Pages visited, search queries, property views, and interactions on the platform.
Browser type, IP address, and device identifiers for security and analytics.
Messages and comments you submit through the platform.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
uses: Provide, operate, and improve the Easy Find platform
Verify agent identities and maintain platform integrity
Process payments for boost and verification services
Send transactional emails (OTP codes, listing confirmations, boost notifications)
Send push notifications about new listings and platform updates (with your consent)
Analyse usage patterns to improve search and discovery
Detect and prevent fraud, spam, or abuse
Respond to your support requests and inquiries

sections.title: 3. Information Sharing
sections.data_sale_policy: We do not sell your personal data.

sharing_circumstances.details: Agent names, profile photos, stands, and property listings are publicly visible to help buyers find agents.
Paystack (payments), Smile ID (identity verification), Google (OAuth login, Analytics), OneSignal (push notifications), EmailJS (contact forms).
When required by Nigerian law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.
In the event of a merger or acquisition, your data may be transferred as part of the business assets.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
security_measures: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt — we never store plain-text passwords
All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS/TLS
Session cookies use httpOnly, secure, and sameSite flags
Payment processing is handled entirely by Paystack — we do not handle card data
Biometric verification is processed by Smile ID under their security protocols
API rate limiting protects against brute-force attacks
sections.disclaimer: No system is 100% secure. While we do our best to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. Report any security concerns to info@easyfind.com.ng.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Tracking

cookie_purposes.description: To keep you logged in across pages
To remember your cookie consent and settings
Google Analytics (anonymised) to understand how people use the platform

sections.user_control: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some platform features like staying logged in.

sections.title: 6. Push Notifications
details: Push notifications are opt-in — you must click 'Allow' in your browser to receive them
You can unsubscribe at any time through your browser notification settings
We may use push notifications to alert you about new listings, boost activations, and account updates
Anonymous visitors who subscribe receive general property alerts; logged-in agents receive targeted account notifications

rights_list.description: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Update incorrect or incomplete information via your account settings
Request deletion of your account and associated data
Request your data in a machine-readable format
Unsubscribe from push notifications or marketing emails at any time

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.policy: Easy Find is not directed at children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
actions_on_change: Update the 'Last updated' date at the top of this page
Notify registered agents by email or push notification
sections.acceptance_terms: Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: 11. Contact Us
sections.sla_response: We take your privacy seriously and will respond to all requests within 30 days.
